author: Zephyr II
title: PPO‑Clip — 5‑step LN‑ConvLSTM(64) — clip range sweep {0.15, 0.20, 0.25}
abstract: Sweep PPO clip_range for 5‑step(64ch) to probe stability/efficiency under the 45‑min cap. Fixed: value_clip=0.2, entropy=0.01, lr=4e‑4; other settings match the 4‑step PPO baseline.
